item.title: Wrong-way pursuit from Virginia ends in Maryland; minivan found abandoned, suspect missing
item.description: A Virginia State Police pursuit that began in Fairfax County crossed state lines into Maryland after the driver allegedly traveled the wrong way on Route 1 and Interstate 495. The vehicle was later found abandoned.

item.title: DC man gets 8 months in prison for high-speed chase, ramming into US Marshal vehicle
item.description: A 28-year-old man will spend eight months behind bars after his dangerous attempt to evade arrest resulted in two crashes, both with U.S. Marshal's vehicles.

item.title: Buddhist monks meet members of Congress after 2,300-mile 'Walk for Peace'
item.description: Enormous crowds gathered in the District Wednesday to greet a group of Buddhist monks as they wrapped up a 2,300-mile peace walk across nine states.Thousands of people were at the Lincoln Memorial Wednesday for one of the final stops of the monks. The monks started their journey in Texas back in October. item.title: VA Democrats vote to approve proposed redistricting map
item.description: Virginia Democrats approved a proposed congressional map Tuesday that could significantly reshape the state’s political landscape ahead of the 2026 midterms.

item.title: AAA: A $20 car wash now could save you hundreds later
item.description: This week, the DMV is finally seeing some good weather. Officials with AAA said you may want to use it to be good to your car.According to AAA research, Americans spend $3 billion a year on repairs from rust damage caused by de-icers. item.title: Suspect kills self after fatally shooting woman, injuring 12-year-old girl in DC: police
item.description: A woman was killed, and a 12-year-old girl was injured in a shooting in Northwest D.C. Wednesday afternoon, according to police. The suspect in the shooting has killed himself, police say. D.C. Interim Police Chief Jeffery Carroll says this was a domestic incident that turned tragic.
